newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daihatsu to boost minivan output by 50%.
newsitem.headline: Daihatsu to boost minivan output by 50%.

text.p: Daihatsu Motor Co Ltd will increase production of Toyota Motor Corp's new TownAce Noah and LiteAce Noah minivans and their commercial versions by 50 percent, a Daihatsu spokesman said on Wednesday.
The company, owned 33.4 percent by Toyota, initially planned to produce 6,500 TownAce Noahs and LiteAce Noahs and 3,500 of the commercial versions per month.
But it now plans to produce the vehicles at a monthly rate of 15,000 units from this month until at least March next year, due to unexpectedly strong demand, the spokesman said.
It said Toyota received 23,000 domestic orders for the minivans in the first 16 days after their launch on October 23. It expects orders to reach 30,000 in the first month.
Daihatsu produces all of Toyota's new TownAce and LiteAce models. It said its plant in Osaka would operate six days a week from November until at least March to keep up with orders.
